subject: E-6192: cannot write data directory on macOS
body:
Regards, Omar Haddad, Tessa Labs

Hi, I'm using Tallyboard 1.9.6 on macOS 15.3. Starting last week, the moment I save my work a dialog
reads "E-6192: cannot write to data directory".

The system drive is nearly full, under one gigabyte left. Other programs have started complaining
about space as well.

Before writing in I tried rebooting the router; same error afterwards.
